about: A language server, formatter and linter for Quarto and other Markdown flavors.

prs.title: A table right after a list stays outside the list
prs.broken: Formatting a document indented a table that came straight after a bullet list, which moved the table into the last list item when rendered.
prs.changed: A table after a list now stays flush left, so it remains its own block.
prs.matters: Formatting no longer changes how a document renders.

prs.title: Line wrapping no longer turns references into list items
prs.broken: Wrapping a list item could put a reference like @fig-scatter. at the start of a line, where Pandoc and Quarto read it as a new list item and lost the reference.
prs.changed: The wrapper now keeps those references off the start of a line.
